heading: Storage / callback errors (-400..-499)
text:
## Storage / callback errors (-400..-499) [NERR.7]

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`  | a `call` fired with no call callback registered — **not** the cache verbs, which fall back to a volatile in-engine cache ([NSTG.2.1]) |
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_QUERY_FAILED` | propagated verbatim from a callback that returned it |
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND`    | integrator-driven from a storage-query callback; **not** a cache read — a `cached()` miss is engine-local and returns null, never this ([NSTG.2.2]) |
